title: Velocity at B
description: Essential: Correctly calculates v_B = 10 m/s using energy conservation from A to B.

title: Velocity at C (first collision)
description: Essential: Correctly calculates v_C = 9 m/s using work-energy from B to C, accounting for friction.

title: Total energy dissipated
description: Important: Correctly applies mgh = μmg * d_total to find the total sliding distance (50 m) on the horizontal surface.

title: Collision count logic
description: Important: Correctly determines the number of round trips (3) by comparing the total distance to the pattern of distances between B and C.

title: Final position calculation
description: Important: Correctly computes the remaining distance after the last full trip and determines the final stopping point (7 m from B).

title: Energy conservation setup
description: Optional: Explicitly states the use of the work-energy theorem for the frictionless arc and the rough horizontal section.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (m, s, m/s) throughout the solution.

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns sign to the work done by friction (should be negative).

title: Collision speed assumption
description: Pitfall: Assumes speed is lost in collisions (it is not; rebounds with same speed).

title: Distance pattern mistake
description: Pitfall: Miscalculates the total distance for multiple trips (e.g., forgetting to double the BC distance for return trips).
